summary_rationale: On a strictly price-blind business and forensic audit, TSMC qualifies cleanly as a COMPOUNDER_PASS. Over FY2016-FY2025, TSMC compounded USD revenue from $29.43B to $122.42B (+35.9% YoY in FY2025) and accelerated to $46.72B in Q3 2026 (+41.2% YoY) with October 2026 monthly sales up 59.7% YoY. Its pure-play foundry neutrality, Open Innovation Platform (OIP) lock-in, 15.0M 12-inch equivalent wafer learning-curve scale, and CoWoS advanced packaging bottleneck (scaling toward 120k-140k WPM by end-2026) give it an effective merchant monopoly at <=5nm (79% of Q3 2026 wafer revenue from <=7nm, including 33% N3 and 8% N2). Financially, TSMC delivered 10 consecutive years of positive FCF ($31.99B in FY2025), CFO/Net Income conversion of 132.4% ($72.52B CFO), a ~$66B net cash fortress ($97.6B cash & marketable securities vs. $31.7B total debt), tightening working capital (DSO 27.0 days, DIO 68.8 days), and 24.6% FY2025 ROIC (32.67% TTM). kpi_health is set to PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unconditional PASS solely to monitor three structural risks: (1) capex escalation to $60B-$64B in FY2026, (2) 2%-4% gross margin dilution from overseas fabs (Arizona, Kumamoto, Dresden), and (3) customer/geographic concentration (NVIDIA 19%, Apple 17%; Taiwan >85% leading-edge capacity).
